scope: Independently authored, simpler text-only diagnostic probes; benchmark-informed skill selection only. Not training data, an MMMU score, or identical-item paired interventions.

sampling.selection: Purposive broad coverage informed by the closed 102-item subject/question metadata; not random or representative.
sampling.pairing: Each pair shares a general skill. K1 recalls a definition/rule; K2 applies it to new exact text state without supplying the rule or result.
sampling.comparison_limit: K1/K2 and stored original-image K3 differ in item content and complexity; counts or accuracy cannot establish module responsibility or a causal knowledge deficit.
sampling.prompt_contract: Use the existing T0 final-answer instruction with A-D options. No answer-key content, images, prior responses, or pair partner may enter the independent request.
